jobs.title: Werkstudent*in (w/m/d) in der Redaktion von Design Perspectives
jobs.company: German Design Council - Rat für Formgebung
jobs.description: Der German Design Council ist die Instanz für Design in Deutschland. Seit 1953. Als Thought Leader entfalten wir das Potenzial von Design für eine nachhaltige Zukunft. Dafür bringen wir Wirtschaft und Design zusammen – für Circular Design, Transformation und wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Design Perspectives ist das Online-Magazin des German Design Council. Deine Aufgaben Du recherchierst passendes Bildmaterial, schneidest es zu und klärst die Bildrechte. Du unterstützt uns bei der Umsetzung unseres Newsletters. Du pflegst Texte und Bilder im TYPO3-Backend ein und hältst den Redaktionsplan aktuell. Du gestaltest zielgruppengerechte Visuals für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle mit Tools wie Figma und Canva. Du unterstützt bei der Organisation und der Kommunikation des Design Perspectives Podcasts. Das bringst Du mit Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben. Ein Gespür für Bildsprache und die Auswahl passender Motive. Kenntnisse in MS Office sowie in Design-Tools wie Canva oder Figma. Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Social-Media-Visuals. Du nutzt Instagram und LinkedIn gern und hast ein Auge dafür, welche Inhalte dort funktionieren. Benefits Es erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem lebendigen, kreativen und vielseitigen Team. Bei uns kannst du Themen setzen und deine eigenen Fähigkeiten weiterentwickeln, neue Ideen einbringen und umsetzen. Zudem bieten wir dir ein kostenfreies Yoga- und Personal Training und eine hervorragende Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zu unseren Büros im Frankfurter Messeturm. Klingt gut? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive aller üblichen Unterlagen sowie Angaben zu Verfügbarkeit Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. As a Brand designer, you own how Fuse looks. You take our new identity, Fuse Brand 2.0, and turn it into a system the whole company can use, then carry it into everything we put into the world: national campaigns, billboards and TV ads, the website and app, merch, engineer uniforms and vans, and the hardware we build. With a new identity landing and launches every month, few brands will give you this much to define. What you'll do Build and own the Fuse visual identity system: type, colour, photography, illustration, layout, and how they flex from a sticker to a billboard Write the guidelines and templates that let creators, producers and agencies stay on brand without you in the room Design the big brand moments yourself: campaign identities, out of home, launches, packaging, merch, uniforms and van livery Art direct the look of shoots and work with motion, graphic design and our agency partners so everything feels like one brand Hold the bar on every piece of work that carries the Fuse name, and evolve the brand as we expand into new countries and products Requirements Two things matter most: Taste. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech. Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. jobs.description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed The mission Every month, millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure, right inside the websites they read and the brands they like. We're looking for a Product Designer to own how these conversations look, feel and work. About 90% of the work is consumer-facing, and the need keeps growing: we want someone to build this with us over the long run. jobs.title: UX Designer
jobs.description: AI doesn't run in one place anymore. It runs in the browser tab, the desktop app, the agent your engineers kicked off, and the copilot embedded in the tools you already pay for. Harmonic Security governs all of it. Our AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform sits on the device, inside the interaction, at the moment of action, reading what AI is actually doing (not just the traffic around it) and acting in real time. Security teams get full visibility and control across every AI surface, including the agentic and MCP layer that traditional tools can't see. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down. We're gaining serious traction at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel. As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build. How We Work: AI-First by Design Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity. For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive. About the Team Our Product Delivery team is the engine that turns vision into impact. We ship early and often, getting valuable features into the hands of customers quickly and iterating from there. We work in the open by default, sharing progress and ideas, and we trust each other to own out

We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less. The Opportunity - Senior Product Designer II (Remote - USA / CANADA) We are looking for a Senior Product Designer II to own design for a core product area at Wrapbook. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who frames the problem and drives work from definition through delivery without waiting for the "what." You'll take on broad, cross cutting work where requirements evolve and no clear solution exists upfront, then create the structure and clarity that carries a cohesive end to end experience across systems and surfaces. Your work will set the bar the team calibrates against, and others will be able to point to decisions you made that changed the direction of a project. What you'll do: Own a product area end to end with minimal direction, framing loosely defined problems and delivering grounded, defensible work across systems and user surfaces even when the right approach is not defined at the start. Above all, you are authentic, collaborative, and energized by solving meaningful problems with cross-functional teams. Here’s What You’ll Be Doing Day-to-Day: Own End-to-End Product Design – Lead design from early problem definition and exploration through prototyping, launch, and iteration across PadSplit’s marketplace. jobs.title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
jobs.description: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them. Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale. Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director. What You'll Do Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use. Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints. Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise

jobs.title: CDI - DESIGNER JUNIOR JERSEY (H/F)
jobs.description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE ROLE Rattaché(e) à la Head of Design, vous intervenez sur la création des collections homme et femme, jersey, bain et flou show, des recherches d'images jusqu'au suivi des prototypes en normalisation. Ce poste couvre à la fois la création et le développement produit : vous travaillez en lien avec les usines partenaires et participez au bien aller de chaque pièce. VOS MISSIONS Réaliser les recherches iconographiques et construire les boards de collection Mener les recherches de volumes, de finitions et de graphismes Réaliser les visuels sur Photoshop et les maquettes Assurer le sourcing matière É
